_about: How good each SOLO vessel is in each element's game, S (the best of the fleet) to C (the least): a person's call, rated by Shombith (Rev 84, section 155 of Docs/MENU_REDESIGN_B.md, 2026-11-10). Each vessel names its elements with a letter; a vessel left out, or an element left out, shows as not rated yet. Only elements the vessel has an arcade game of can be rated: the generator drops a letter for an element with no game and warns. Crews are never rated. Add `_by` and `_date` per vessel when a letter changes.
